title: Atlantis search: Atlantic region matching Plato's description

tellings.quote: we believe we found the a region in the u Atlantic that is uh fits all the descriptions of Plato's d in Plato's dialogues

plain: A team says it has found a region of the Atlantic Ocean that matches every detail the ancient Greek philosopher Plato gave of Atlantis, the lost island he described in his dialogues. Tim Gallaudet, a retired US Navy admiral who says he is part of the search, tells Jesse Michels this, naming a colleague, Maaneli Derakhshani, and keeping the location secret. If true, Atlantis would be a real place under the sea.
